certification.name: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
certification.description: Entry-level Microsoft Azure cloud fundamentals certification. Domain weights below follow Microsoft's published AZ-900 skills-measured outline.

domains.name: Describe cloud concepts
domains.description: cloud models (public/private/hybrid), IaaS/PaaS/SaaS, shared responsibility model, consumption-based pricing (CapEx vs OpEx), benefits of high availability, scalability, elasticity, reliability, and disaster recovery

domains.name: Describe Azure architecture and services
domains.description: regions, region pairs, availability zones, resource groups, subscriptions, management groups; matching core Azure services (Virtual Machines, App Service, Azure Functions, Blob Storage, SQL Database, Virtual Network) to the workload or description they fit

domains.name: Describe Azure management and governance
domains.description: Azure Policy, role-based access control (RBAC), resource locks and tags, Azure Cost Management, the correct order to create/secure/govern resources, and deploying resources safely via the portal or CLI
